description.zh-CN: 面向企业产品的 React 组件库与设计语言，适合表单、表格和复杂业务界面。
description.en: A React component library and design language for enterprise products, forms and data-heavy interfaces.

description.zh-CN: React 组件库与设计系统，可查阅组件能力、主题配置和使用文档。
description.en: A React component library and design system with component, theme and integration documentation.

description.zh-CN: Vue 3 组件库，适合业务表单、数据展示与后台应用。
description.en: A Vue 3 component library for business forms, data display and administrative applications.

description.zh-CN: 腾讯开源的企业级设计体系，具体框架实现和组件文档见上游项目。
description.en: Tencent’s open-source enterprise design system; consult the upstream project for framework implementations and component documentation.

description.zh-CN: 基于 React、Tailwind CSS 和 React Aria 的设计系统，提供组件、图表与 AI 界面；免费组件之外另有付费 Pro 组件和模板。
description.en: A React design system using Tailwind CSS and React Aria, with components, charts and AI interfaces; Pro components and templates require a paid license.

description.zh-CN: 可在线体验的 React 交互组件与微动效集合，涵盖拖拽、悬停、选择器和加载反馈，适合寻找交互灵感与实现参考。
description.en: A collection of interactive React components and micro-interactions, with live drag, hover, picker and loading examples for design and implementation reference.

description.zh-CN: HeroUI 的付费组件与模板产品，面向 React 和 React Native 应用；公开文档可供评估，受保护源码与下载需相应授权。
description.en: HeroUI’s premium components and templates for React and React Native applications; public docs support evaluation, while protected source and downloads require an eligible license.

description.zh-CN: 面向 React 与 Next.js 的付费动效区块和完整页面模板，使用 Tailwind CSS 与 Motion，提供源码及组件注册表接入。
description.en: Premium animated blocks and full-page templates for React and Next.js, using Tailwind CSS and Motion with source files and registry integration.

description.zh-CN: React 视觉效果库集合，包含流光边框、思考光球、液态金属与 Gooey 效果；提供免费 npm 库，深度定制 Studio 另属 Pro 方案。
description.en: A collection of React visual-effect libraries including border beams, thinking orbs, liquid metal and gooey effects; free npm libraries are complemented by a paid Pro customization Studio.

description.zh-CN: 免费的开源 React UI 资源平台，提供 Tailwind CSS 与 shadcn/ui 组件、动效、页面区块、仪表盘和模板，可浏览示例并查阅安装文档。
description.en: A free, open-source React UI platform offering Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui components, animations, page blocks, dashboards and templates with examples and installation docs.

description.zh-CN: 第三方网站设计语言分析集合，可参考排版、色彩和布局规则；不是对应品牌的官方规范。
description.en: A collection of third-party website design analyses covering typography, color and layout; not official specifications from those brands.

description.zh-CN: 面向设计工程的 Skill 集合与获取工具，首批收录 Baseline UI。
description.en: Design engineering skills and discovery tools; the initial Atlas selection includes Baseline UI.

description.zh-CN: Emil Kowalski 整理的设计与工程 Skills，涵盖动效构建、审核、性能和边界数据测试。
description.en: Emil Kowalski’s design and engineering skills, including animation construction, review, performance and worst-case data testing.

description.zh-CN: 列表中收藏的开发者路线图仓库，用于规划学习路径；具体内容与项目来源以仓库说明为准。
description.en: The developer roadmap repository saved in the list, useful for planning learning paths; consult its README for content and project provenance.
